title: Alumina Silicata
text: This remedy is indicated in cases of respiratory and digestive disorders. It is useful in cases of chronic catarrh and chronic inflammation of the mucous membranes. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of skin diseases. Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo. Chronic catarrh of the nose. Dryness and obstruction. Sneezing. Appetite poor. Nausea. Heaviness and pressure after eating. Distended with gas. Flatulence. Chronic constipation. Shortness of breath on motion. Violent cough, ending in sneezing. Hoarseness. Dry and scaly. Itching and burning. Compare: Alumina; Silicea; Calcarea carbonica. Third to thirtieth potency.
